basis: C014/FEED-009 retain MOBIUS as an unconfirmed finite-field transformation clue; no previous run tested a concrete Möbius operation.
The simplest finite-field special case is inversion x->1/x on nonzero elements; the required pole handling is explicitly frozen as f(0)=0 and is not inferred from output.
H013 and H014 tested fixed affine and fixed repeating-key transfers without LP2 leads; this is a new zero-preserving finite-field map family with no key or stream tuning.
hypothesis: The LP2 rune ordinal stream contains a language-aligned signal after the fixed Z/29 inversion map f(0)=0 and f(x)=x^(-1) mod29 on nonzero ordinals.
mechanistic_basis: Möbius inversion x->1/x is defined on the projective line; this experiment restricts to the 29 rune ordinals with the single preregistered finite-domain convention 0->0. The map is an involution and introduces no key, exponent search, page tuning or delimiter edits.
falsifiable_predictions: The fixed inversion is a bijection and involution on 0..28, and preserves the raw page layout when applied only to rune ordinals.
At least one of the 55 applicable LP2 pages has a fixed-inversion H009 training-only unigram mean score at maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 against 256 random zero-preserving permutation controls.
Independent direct modular inversion reproduces every fixed output and exact inverse roundtrip; all controls complete before a lead is reported.
A score lead is a diagnostic candidate only and is not a solved page without an independent plaintext or structural prediction.
page_universe: LP2/0..55; all 55 rune-bearing pages are applicable, LP2/50 has no registered rune symbols and remains excluded.
scope: All 55 applicable LP2 pages and 12956 rune positions; no LP2 literal grid, Latin completion or external data.
algorithm_version: H015-v1: f(0)=0; f(x)=pow(x,27,29) for x in 1..28. Apply once per rune, preserve every non-rune character.
parameter_derivation_policy: The inversion map and zero convention are fixed from the single concrete MOBIUS special case before reading output. Control maps, seed, scorer, maxT correction and acceptance are fixed before decoding.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: The map is memoryless and page-local; no cross-page clock, reset, key, separator consumption or transposition is introduced.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: Per-page mean of H009's additive-smoothed training-only unigram log weights; no candidate-specific retuning or word completion.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.controls: 256 unique random permutations of nonzero ordinals 1..28 with zero fixed, excluding the registered inversion map; standardize each page and use maxT over all 55 pages.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.lead: A page is a diagnostic lead only when fixed inversion p_adjusted<=0.01 after complete controls and validation.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.negative: No lead is negative only for fixed inversion, zero convention, scorer and random zero-preserving permutation null; it does not reject other Möbius, multiplicative or composite mechanisms.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.error_or_timeout: Corpus/source integrity failure, incomplete controls or failed independent inversion is error/timeout/inconclusive, never negative.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes frozen.json with input hashes, fixed map table, control maps, counts and criteria before decoded outputs and statistics.

total_budget.origin: Bounded concrete Möbius-inversion diagnostic for auto-cycle R007; no side-chat budget inherited.

controls: 256 fixed-seed random zero-preserving nonzero permutations, controls only and never candidate keys.
Pinned page order, raw hashes, rune counts and LP2/50 inapplicability checks.
Independent pow(x,27,29) inversion, involution, score replay and raw roundtrip checks.
Original raw delimiters, lines, whitespace and non-rune literals are preserved.

randomness.role: Random control-map generation only; no key, plaintext or answer seed.

discovery_path: One fixed finite-field inversion selected from the MOBIUS clue; no PGL enumeration, dictionary search or post-hoc pole rule.
independent_validation_path: A separate direct loop recomputes zero handling, pow-based inverse, involution and per-page scores without calling the observed map helper.
correlated_transform_deduplication: The inversion map is tested once. Random nonzero permutations are controls, not 256 extra hypotheses; maxT covers the 55 page cells.
uncovered_parameters: Other Möbius/PGL maps, pole encodings and projective-line extra symbols
Power/exponent maps, affine shifts, keyed/stream/composite transforms
LP2 literal grid, alternate glyph readings and independent plaintext prediction
CIRCUMFERENCE, geometry and other untested key derivations
next_step: If a lead appears, register an independent prediction before interpreting it; otherwise the method family is scoped negative and the cycle stops at R007's cap.
note: The 0->0 convention is an explicit finite-domain patch, not evidence that the puzzle uses this Möbius map.
